scope: Prisma configuration, User/Session/MFA declarations and restore encryption preflight

catalogue.method: Read-only comparison of all scalar column names, PostgreSQL udt types, nullability and defaults with schema.prisma; relation/index/constraint definitions also reviewed against migrations and consumers. No database access by this check.

before.method: Real bounded backup-file read and digest followed by the previous validateRestoreEnvironment call, matching the CLI step after signature validation. No Prisma or database involved.
failures: Missing MFA key accepted for active seed
Wrong well-formed MFA key accepted for pending seed
Later seed accepted after authenticated owner was changed
Encrypted audit value accepted after authenticated context changed
Authenticated audit payload accepted despite invalid JSON
before.failureKind: Each assert.rejects failed with Missing expected rejection; no import or setup failure.

additionalChecks: Every encrypted row, including later active or pending MFA seeds
Correct user-bound MFA and field-bound audit additional authenticated data
IV, tag, ciphertext and encoded envelope validation
Consumable Base32 MFA and JSON object audit payload
Same FileHandle can be reused; artifact modification between validation passes is refused
after.limits: Twelve tests use temporary local backup fixtures and real Node AES-GCM, not database or browser. The separate coordinator CLI proof covers signed v9 and all 19 tables.
